verdict.rationale: Measuring detection quality is a fair axis for an AML screening and monitoring product. However, the evidence shows no documented capability for evaluating screening or agent output against labelled validation cases, or for computing detection or false-clearance rates. Case decisions, audit trails and data exports are only building blocks a user could analyse externally, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can measure detection quality and incorrect clearances against labelled validation cases
